description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

 

Location: San Francisco Bay Area preferred

What you'll do:

This is a senior individual-contributor role reporting to the Director of Product Marketing. You will be the close go-to-market counterpart to the Senior Product Manager for Platform and a day-to-day partner to the Senior Alliances Marketing Manager. Together with Product, Engineering, Alliances, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and technology alliance partners, you will make complex integrations, APIs, MCP, and developer experiences clear, credible, and commercially compelling.

The market problem you will help solve is bigger than a catalog of connectors: valuable security intelligence is often trapped in a portal, copied into tickets by hand, or disconnected from the workflows where teams act. You will help Horizon3 win by showing how NodeZero can embed into the customer’s existing security stack and contribute to a connected Hack, Fix, Verify loop.

Product Management will own product vision, requirements, roadmap, prioritization, scope, and technical trade-offs. You will own how the value is positioned, launched, activated, adopted, sold, and proven in the market.

Own the platform integrations narrative

  • Build and evolve the positioning and messaging for NodeZero’s integrations, APIs, MCP, and integration framework.

  • Explain the customer value of putting proven exploitability intelligence into SIEM, SOAR, ITSM, EDR/XDR, vulnerability-management, and other security workflows.

  • Create a coherent platform story that connects native integrations, partner-built experiences, developer access, and agent connectivity without reducing the message to “we integrate with X.”

  • Develop audience- and use-case-specific narratives for security executives, security operations and vulnerability-management leaders, technical champions, developers, partners, and field teams.

  • Clarify the difference between NodeZero’s high-signal, attacker-validated intelligence and generic telemetry, vulnerability volume, or disconnected point-tool workflows.

Partner with Product and Engineering as the GTM counterpart

  • Operate as part of the product trio with the Senior Product Manager for Platform and Engineering leadership, bringing market, customer, field, and partner evidence into product discussions.

  • Translate product direction, release state, and technical capabilities into accurate external promises, compelling use cases, and actionable launch plans.

  • Stay close to product details, integration behavior, API and MCP experiences, developer readiness, and customer workflows so the market story remains technically credible.

  • Partner on launch timing and readiness while preserving the ownership boundary between product decisions and go-to-market decisions.

  • Help identify adoption friction, messaging gaps, and unmet customer or partner needs that should inform future product iterations.

Lead joint go-to-market with Technology Alliances

  • Work closely with the Senior Alliances Marketing Manager and technology alliance partners to turn selected integrations into coordinated launches and sustained GTM programs.

  • Develop partner value propositions, joint solution narratives, customer use cases, launch briefs, co-marketing plans, marketplace and listing inputs, and joint selling motions.

  • Coordinate partner-facing marketing work across Horizon3 and partner stakeholders without assuming ownership of partnership agreements, commercial terms, or relationship governance.

  • Create “better together” stories that demonstrate how NodeZero and a partner help customers act on proven exploitability in the systems they already use.

  • Build reusable alliance and integration marketing motions that make partner activation more consistent and scalable.

Drive launch readiness, field activation, and adoption

  • Orchestrate launches across Product, Engineering, Alliances, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Demand Generation, Communications, and partner teams.

  • Equip internal and external audiences with messaging, demo flows, talk tracks, FAQs, competitive framing, solution briefs, technical explainers, customer-facing content, and enablement modules.

  • Support readiness across early access, general availability, and follow-on iterations—not only announcement day.

  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success to connect integration capabilities to customer outcomes, adoption paths, expansion opportunities, and time-to-value.

  • Capture field and customer feedback after launch and turn it into practical improvements to positioning, enablement, adoption programs, and future GTM plans.

Build evidence and measurement into the motion

  • Define and track measures that reflect workflow value and commercial impact, not connector count or press-release volume alone.

  • Establish visibility into customer usage, shared-customer activation, adoption and engagement, integration-influenced pipeline, partner-sourced or partner-influenced opportunities, launch performance, and the reach of NodeZero through integrations, APIs, and MCP.

  • Partner with Product, Sales Operations, Customer Success, and Alliances to create a practical measurement approach and use the evidence to improve priorities and programs.

  • Develop customer proof points, references, and use cases that show how platform connectivity changes security-team behavior and outcomes.

Create leverage through repeatable systems

  • Build reusable integration and partner-launch briefs, messaging frameworks, launch checklists, enablement modules, customer-proof templates, and measurement plans.

  • Establish a clear operating rhythm for launch planning, partner coordination, readiness reviews, feedback capture, and post-launch learning.

  • Improve the quality and speed of GTM execution so each new integration does not require inventing a marketing motion from scratch.

  • Stay close enough to actual deals, losses, customer conversations, and partner feedback to ensure the system improves from real evidence.

What Success Looks Like in Your First 6–12 Months

  • A clear, differentiated platform integrations narrative is used consistently across the website, sales conversations, partner materials, launches, and executive communications.

  • Priority integrations and platform capabilities have coordinated GTM plans, accurate positioning, launch-readiness materials, field enablement, and post-launch adoption follow-through.

  • The Product, Alliances, and Marketing teams share a repeatable operating model for turning integration work into joint launches, customer proof, and measurable business impact.

  • Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and partner teams can confidently explain, demonstrate, position, and activate the relevant integration and API/MCP use cases.

  • Horizon3 has a practical measurement framework for customer usage, workflow adoption, shared-customer activation, pipeline influence, partner contribution, and platform reach.

  • Customer, field, and partner evidence is consistently fed back into Product and Engineering discussions to improve the next iteration.

  • Reusable GTM systems reduce the effort required to launch and scale additional integrations and technology-alliance motions.

What You’ll Bring

  • Experience in product marketing for technical B2B products, platforms, integrations, developer-facing products, or technology ecosystems.

  • A track record of taking ambiguous product or market problems from insight through positioning, launch, enablement, adoption, and measurement.

  • The ability to understand technical products—including APIs, data flows, integration patterns, developer experiences, or agent connectivity—and translate them into clear customer and business value.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to influence Product, Engineering, Alliances, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and external partners without relying on formal authority.

  • Experience developing positioning, messaging, launch plans, sales enablement, customer-facing content, and partner-facing materials.

  • Commercial judgment: you can connect product capabilities to customer workflows, pipeline, adoption, expansion, and retention without overstating product truth.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to make complex concepts clear for both technical and executive audiences.

  • Comfort using qualitative and quantitative evidence to make decisions, measure performance, and improve GTM programs.

  • A collaborative working style and the judgment to distinguish shared execution from direct ownership.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in cybersecurity, security operations, vulnerability management, exposure management, IT operations, or adjacent enterprise technology markets.

  • Experience marketing integrations across SIEM, SOAR, ITSM, EDR/XDR, vulnerability-management, cloud, identity, or related security ecosystems.

  • Experience with APIs as a product surface, developer portals, MCP, agent workflows, marketplaces, or partner-built integrations.

  • Experience leading technology-alliance launches, co-marketing programs, marketplace listings, joint solution narratives, or partner enablement.

  • Experience working with a product-led, platform, ecosystem, or consumption-oriented business model.

  • Experience building repeatable operating systems for launches, enablement, customer proof, or GTM measurement.

What We’re Looking For

  • High agency: you can take an unclear problem, establish the next right actions, bring the right people together, and drive the work to a shipped outcome.

  • Whole-company awareness: you optimize for customer value and business results rather than treating content, launches, or partner activity as ends in themselves.

  • Technical curiosity: you are willing to go deep into product behavior, integration details, customer workflows, and partner requirements to get the story right.

  • Craftsmanship and precision: you care about the accuracy of claims, the quality of the customer experience, and the details that determine whether field teams can use what you create.

  • Evidence-oriented ownership: you stay close to customers, deals, losses, usage, and feedback; when something misses, you diagnose the system and improve the next action.

  • Influential leadership: you can lead across and up, create alignment among teams with different incentives, and keep momentum without creating unnecessary process.

  • Humility and clarity: you know what you own, what you share, and when to bring in Product, Engineering, Alliances, or other partners.

Travel Requirements

  • Occasional travel as needed for customer meetings, partner engagements, team gatherings, industry events, and launches. 

Perks of Horizon3

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

  • Base salary range: $180,000 - $225,000 annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. 

Application Note

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.
